title: Content Atom
description: VENDORED COPY, fetched from the synced repo cgen/trainstorm-core/schemas/atom.schema.json. DO NOT EDIT — the canonical source is the git repo; re-fetch before trusting for a production run. A thin content atom: stable identity + the invariant meaning payload + keyed bindings (references) into the sub-models. Renderings live in external stores keyed by atom_id. One agent owns each binding (single-writer). [Note: intent/expression binding property defs are elided from this vendored copy; they validate via bindings.additionalProperties as generic objects and are not written by Headwater. object/audience/governance are verbatim.]

atom_id.description: Stable, opaque, durable identity. The single join key across the object graph, every locale pack, the registries, and the learner model. Never reused, never edited.

content_hash.description: Hash of the meaning payload. Detects when meaning actually changed (invalidating downstream renderings) versus when only structure moved.

meaning.description: The invariant truth the atom owns. The ONLY embedded payload.

bindings.description: Keyed references into the sub-models. Extensible: new facet types may be added as agents need them. Each binding is owned by exactly one agent.

object.description: Structure. Owner: Content Architecture / Headwater at origin.

audience.description: Fit hooks only. Holds NO learner PII.
